Regular Council
Regular Council meetings are held on the second Wednesday of each month, with Closed Session starting at 5:30 p.m. when required, and Open Session starting at 6:30 p.m. Meetings are held as hybrid meetings to allow for in person and electronic participation. Residents may attend the meeting in person in Council Chambers at the Township's Municipal Centre or watch the live stream.
  Members of the Public wishing to submit Public Comments can do so in writing to the Clerk no later than 12:00 pm (noon) on the day of the meeting. Members of the Public may request their comments to be read by the Clerk or present their comments orally. Only Public Comments related to an item on the agenda listed under Reports, Correspondence and By-laws will be considered.

Council Correspondence Agenda
On July 12, 2023 the Council of the Township of Adjala-Tosorontio enacted a Policy for the handling and distribution of correspondence received by the Clerk - known as the Correspondence Policy. 
 The Correspondence Agenda is published on the last Wednesday of each month, and will include a descriptive title, brief summary and any attachments for each item of correspondence.
